title: History of Vietnamese Culture
duration: 45 hours (30 hours of lectures and 15 hours of seminars/practicals)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the origins, development, and transformation of Vietnamese culture, its interactions with other cultures, and its distinctive characteristics and values.
Analyze historical periods of Vietnamese culture from traditional to modern times.
Apply knowledge of Vietnamese culture in business contexts, particularly in the tourism and hospitality industry.
Effectively present and discuss cultural topics in group settings.
Work collaboratively in groups to complete assignments and projects.
Demonstrate self-discipline and responsibility in academic and professional settings.
Respect and appreciate cultural diversity, and understand the importance of preserving and promoting traditional Vietnamese culture.
